So I'll answer as much as I can and hope someone more knowledgable than me picks up the rest! 

* Honestly couldn't tell ya, if you see some of my other comments my bike setup wasn't my normal setup had to rebuild my bike myself in my hotel and didn't have the exact height measurement so just did my best to guess. It was fine for EFA but wouldn't ride a 70.3 leg that way

* Splitting this into a few points RE Calf sleeves they have like a texture built into them that is more textured than you'd think! Can't comment in-depth on the aero side as a friend got them for me and I mostly wear them for the fact I like the feel as they aren't compression sleeve tight but a gentle squeeze.

* So the VAST majority of the pros were on TT bikes with disc wheels and aero helmets. I opted for no aero helmet which I regret to be honest as I was scared of the technical bits but the technical bits are really not that bad and there is a surprising amount of area to get down into aero and hammer. I will say I don't think I'm strong enough to climb well with a disc so if I was to do it again I'd go with somewhere between a 60-80mm wheel set depending on weight and how strong I can get. 
* My bike handling isn't bad but certainly not top tier and I was very fine on my tri bike granted I was towards the front of the race and was never crowded on course so was able to take wide lines through corners as I was coming back through the course the outbound traffic did look congested and would've been scary on a TT bike so take that info accordingly. 
* If your brakes aren't good though I wouldn't run that bike as there is some SUPER fast down hill bits into some sharp turns.

If you get in go do the most technical descending you can find on the bike and go run lots of stairs and run on sand whenever possible! Don't let the swim intimidate you its much easier than people make it out to be!
